scope: Acceptance links, not execution results. Exact build outcomes live in run ledgers. Partial inventory; not all UI paths covered.

IDE-005.contract: Named dirty buffers saved independently; untitled skipped and reported; write failure never reports global success; recoverable changes survive.

IDE-006.contract: Save/Discard/Cancel reviews the correct document; Cancel keeps it open and unchanged.

IDE-007.contract: All dirty documents reviewed; Cancel keeps IDE alive; clean exit after decisions.

IDE-019.contract: Real entries only; filter, Enter jump, Esc retains cursor; Delete does not invoke Ctrl+G.

IDE-020.contract: HBP parsed and preserved; opening never executes build hooks.

IDE-021.contract: Source desktop and build act on selected project; diagnostics target correct file.

IDE-026.contract: List marks dirty and switches selected buffer without crossing state.

IDE-027.contract: Real compiler messages list and navigate to correct source.

IDE-028.contract: Next diagnostic wraps with correct line and status.

IDE-029.contract: Previous diagnostic wraps with correct line and status.

IDE-033.contract: Literal arguments reach Start/Script/Debug; shell metacharacters cannot execute commands.

DBG-004.contract: Alt+X aborts debuggee, not IDE; colors/menu restored; next session clean.

DBG-012.contract: Application screen round trip restores debugger; visual buffer correctness still requires pixels.

DBG-014.contract: All statements execute and return to IDE; application nested display count preserved; visual tearing separate.

DBG-037.contract: ON enters extended block; OFF steps past; fresh sessions tested.

DBG-038.contract: Hide, temporary Alt menu, Esc rehide, Alt+O,M restore; explicit ON/OFF and settings round trip.

DBG-043.contract: ON/OFF affect real startup stopping in fresh sessions, not only check mark.

IDE-015.contract: Search next position case-insensitively; wrap within current and other lines; missing match retains cursor.

IDE-016.contract: Repeat visits adjacent and overlapping matches without double increment, then wraps.

IDE-001.contract: File New creates an independent live buffer; text, cursor, selection, undo, breakpoints and journals stay with their document.

IDE-002.contract: Open dialog loads requested file as its own buffer; deep paths and byte-preserving reload covered. Not every dialog input is covered.

IDE-003.contract: F2/save retains tested EOL, tabs, encoding and BOM; failed atomic writes do not replace original; recovery generation removed only after save. Not all file types certified.

IDE-004.contract: Save As creates named target and refuses a route already owned by another live document; refusal and crash retain recovery.

IDE-008.contract: Undo restores tested character/structural edits, terminators and soft-wrap metadata; saved-state and document isolation covered. Not every edit sequence certified.

IDE-009.contract: Redo reapplies tested edits without losing EOL, TAB or soft-wrap state, within the correct document.

IDE-011.contract: Model Cut removes selected span as one undoable operation, preserving final fragment terminator; TAB is one source byte. Real Edit-menu dispatch now checks exact saved bytes.

IDE-012.contract: Model Paste inserts multiline clipboard at EOF and restores exact original boundaries on undo. Real Edit-menu dispatch now checks exact saved bytes.

IDE-013.contract: Model Delete Line and undo preserve final-line boundary; real deletion keeps breakpoint marks attached to surviving instructions. Real Edit-menu dispatch checks exact saved bytes; coverage is partial.

IDE-014.contract: Model Duplicate Line at unterminated EOF creates preferred boundary; undo/redo restore original bytes. Real Edit-menu dispatch now checks exact saved bytes.

IDE-017.contract: Model Replace All changes text while preserving mixed boundaries and undo; real Replace modal input/dispatch and undo also check exact saved bytes.

IDE-023.contract: Ctrl+F6 switches live documents, preserving editor state and isolation.

IDE-024.contract: Ctrl+Shift+F6 returns to the prior live document with cursor, undo and breakpoint state preserved.

IDE-010.contract: Real Edit Copy then Paste duplicates the intended current line; saved EOL/TAB bytes and Cut/Undo are checked. Range Copy has separate model coverage, not all clipboard paths.
